up: Return the ChEMBL IDs (molecule_chembl_id), preferred names (pref_name), and canonical SMILES for all compounds that are reported in the document identified by ChEMBL document ID CHEMBL2095176. Join compound_records to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to retrieve these fields.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM compound_records cr JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2095176';
